violations.why: The task reads v_quiver[36] via v_pylon in v_quartz, and the ISR can write v_quiver[36] through v_summit before the task writes it back with v_ember(36, ...).
The task writes v_quiver[36] in the init loop. After v_amber sets the pointers, the ISR can overwrite v_quiver[36] before the task reads it in v_pylon.
